research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Tessera Therapeutics is developing LTR retrotransposon compositions and methods, including IAP LTR retrotransposon compositions and methods, to alter genomes at defined loci. They design modified UTRs for retrotransposon systems and untranslated region and poly A tail sequences for use in methods and compositions for genome modification, including poly A tail sequences for use in methods and compositions for genome engineering. Together these efforts focus on precise genome editing and optimized gene modifying payload expression.

overview_description.description: Tessera Therapeutics develops gene writing technology to modify DNA sequences within human cells for therapeutic use. The company focuses on Gene Writing, a platform that enables the insertion, deletion, or replacement of genetic material without relying on traditional gene editing approaches. Its work involves studying mobile genetic elements and engineering them into tools that can rewrite sections of the genome. Tessera Therapeutics applies this technology to research programs targeting genetic diseases by aiming to correct underlying mutations at their source. The company also conducts preclinical studies to evaluate the safety, delivery, and durability of its gene writing methods.

about_short_description.short_description: Tessera Therapeutics develops gene writing technology designed to modify DNA sequences within human cells for therapeutic use.

product.name: Gene Writing™
product.description: A genome-engineering platform that uses RNA templates and Gene Writer proteins to make precise DNA substitutions, insertions, deletions, exon replacements, and whole-gene integrations without double-strand DNA breaks.

product.name: Targeted Lipid Nanoparticle (LNP) Delivery Platform
product.description: A proprietary non-viral delivery platform designed to transport all-RNA Gene Writing components to selected cell types, including liver cells, hematopoietic stem cells, and T cells, for in vivo genome engineering.

product.name: TSRA-196
product.description: An investigational in vivo gene-editing therapy for adults with alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (AATD), developed using Tessera’s Gene Writing and targeted LNP delivery platforms.

identifier.value: In Vivo CAR-T Gene Writing Program

product.name: In Vivo CAR-T Gene Writing Program
product.description: An investigational approach that uses RNA Gene Writers and T-cell-targeted LNPs to permanently integrate chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) sequences into T cells directly in the body.

identifier.value: In Vivo Sickle Cell Disease Gene Writing Program

product.name: In Vivo Sickle Cell Disease Gene Writing Program
product.description: An investigational in vivo gene-editing program designed to correct the HBB mutation in hematopoietic stem cells for potential treatment of sickle cell disease.
